key.name: workspace-colors
key.summary: Top bar color for each workspace
key.description: One CSS color per workspace, in order: the first entry is for workspace 1. Accepted forms: #rgb, #rrggbb, rgb(r, g, b) or a color name; no transparency. 'default' keeps the theme's color on that workspace. So does an empty string, an invalid color, or a workspace beyond the end of the list.
